requirements.rule: SHARED RULES: the hourly divisor, the tredicesima, the leave, absence, sickness and accrual rules are those of the scuola file of the same comparto (istruzione-ricerca-aran), not read again for the research bodies. No overtime table is modelled.
requirements.remediation: Read the research sections of the CCNL 2019-2021 (18/1/2024) for leave, absence, sickness and overtime.
